name: sell-your-stuff
description: A simple sale site you can run yourself. List your stuff, take offers and track who's paid.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --port 8791
scripts.dev:hosted: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env hosted && wrangler dev --env hosted --port 8792
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:hosted: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env hosted && wrangler deploy --env hosted

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The password you'll use to sign in at /admin. Make it long and don't reuse one.
